note: Provenance record for docs/contract.json. VCF Automation is not covered by any OpenAPI document in the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository (Apache-2.0). Every operation in the contract was transcribed by hand from the Broadcom xAPIs reference pages listed below.
referenceSet: VCF Automation API | VM Apps Org - Catalog (xAPIs)
referenceSetVersionSelector: latest (portal reports 9.1 as Latest, 9.0 also selectable)
